title: TransportJob
description: The movement of a vehicle between two places. Deliberately not tied to an incident: the same object serves post-repair delivery, end-of-lease collection, auction and dealer transport, and planned maintenance transport, so incidentEnvelopeId is optional. chainEnvelopeId is what makes recovery, depot, garage and return delivery read as one journey rather than four unrelated jobs. Held in the eVault of the organisation that issues it, for the same reason as RecoveryJob: the job must exist before an assignee is known.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the issuing organisation eVault

issuerEName.description: eName of the organisation that issued the job and matches it to a transporter

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle to move

incidentEnvelopeId.description: Present only when the movement originates from an incident

originType.description: What the movement follows from, such as a completed recovery or a repair ready for collection

chainEnvelopeId.description: Groups several movements under one case, so the customer sees one journey. Shared by every job in the chain.

sequenceInChain.description: Place of this movement in its chain, starting at 1

locationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ServiceLocation the vehicle is collected from, where it is one

address.description: Street address of the pick-up, as a person would write it

windowStart.description: Earliest time the vehicle can be collected

windowEnd.description: Latest time the vehicle can be collected

contactEName.description: eName of the person to contact at the pick-up

accessNotes.description: What the driver needs to know to get in and load, such as gate codes or where the keys are

pickup.description: Where and when the vehicle is to be collected

locationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the ServiceLocation the vehicle is delivered to, where it is one

destinationType.description: What kind of place the vehicle is delivered to

address.description: Street address of the destination, as a person would write it

windowStart.description: Earliest time the vehicle can be delivered

windowEnd.description: Latest time the vehicle can be delivered

contactEName.description: eName of the person to contact at the destination

chosenBecause.description: Why this destination was selected: insurer network, owner preference, capability, capacity, distance, reputation. Decided before the job is offered, so the job does not have to be created twice.

destination.description: Where and when the vehicle is to be delivered

vehicleSpec.description: Repeated on the job because the transporter needs it to accept or decline without reading the vehicle eVault

weightKg.description: Weight of the vehicle in kilograms

widthMm.description: Overall width in millimetres, without mirrors

dimensions.description: Size of the vehicle, in millimetres

drivable.description: Whether the vehicle can drive onto the transporter itself

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain of the vehicle. A damaged electric vehicle needs a transporter that may carry one.

covered.description: Whether the vehicle must travel enclosed

slots.description: Number of transporter places the job takes

equipment.description: Equipment the transporter must have, such as a winch

crossBorder.description: Whether the movement crosses a national border

deadlineAt.description: Latest time the vehicle must be delivered

assignedCompanyEName.description: eName of the transport company that accepted the job

assignedAssetEName.description: eName of the specific transporter: a Vehicle whose eVault also holds a ServiceVehicle profile with serviceRole transport

assignedDriverEName.description: eName of the person driving the transporter

routePosition.description: Where this pickup sits in the route the transporter was already driving

detourKm.description: Extra distance this job adds to a route already being driven. The number that makes filling spare capacity visible against a dedicated trip.

candidateEName.description: eName of the transport company that was ranked

rank.description: Place in the ranking, 1 being the best match

score.description: Score the matching gave the candidate. Higher is better.

detourKm.description: Extra kilometres the job would add to the candidate's planned route

reasons.description: Why the candidate got its place, one reason per entry, in words a planner can read

matchRanking.description: Why each candidate ranked where it did, so a planner can trust the result and override it with a reason

status.description: Where the job stands. Every change also writes a CaseEvent.

declineReason.description: Why the offered company declined the job

delayReason.description: Written back to the case on a delay or a failure to load, rather than reported by phone

offeredAt.description: When the job was offered to a company

acceptedAt.description: When the company accepted the job

collectedAt.description: When the vehicle was loaded at the pick-up

deliveredAt.description: When the vehicle was delivered at the destination

expectedArrivalAt.description: Visible to the driver, the owner, the insurer and the receiving garage without any of them having to ask

pickup.description: MetaEnvelope id of the HandoverReceipt signed at the pick-up

delivery.description: MetaEnvelope id of the HandoverReceipt signed at the destination

handoverReceiptEnvelopeIds.description: MetaEnvelope ids of the HandoverReceipts signed at either end of the movement

costRecordEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the record of what this job cost. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

authorisationEnvelopeId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the payer's decision to pay for this job. The ontology for that record is not proposed yet.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
